final_questions.question: Can OptiBrain safely prepare website changes without touching production?
final_questions.answer: YES for isolated local preparation; remote preview automation remains gated.

final_questions.question: Can GitHub proposal branches be created safely?
final_questions.answer: Local branches YES. Remote branch creation is a push/API ref write and remains BLOCKED until independent deployment triggers are audited.

final_questions.question: Can proposal branches be pushed safely?
final_questions.answer: NOT PROVEN today. SSH write capability/dry run pass, but Cloudflare Builds discovery fails; actual push withheld.

final_questions.question: Can Cloudflare create an isolated preview?
final_questions.answer: Supported by the provider, but NOT READY on the current active website setup. A separate isolated preview target/configuration proposal is documented and not applied.

final_questions.question: Can the preview be tied to the exact Git SHA?
final_questions.answer: YES by design using provider version annotations plus generated manifest/artifact digest and CI SHA. Local build is tied to 2db20ef; no hosted SHA proof exists yet.

final_questions.question: Can the existing camera proposal now be reviewed through a real preview?
final_questions.answer: NO. Local current/proposed screenshots and content exist; no real Cloudflare proposal URL.

final_questions.question: Is a draft PR safe?
final_questions.answer: Repository PR workflow is read-only build/test and auto-merge is disabled. Overall safety is unproven because Cloudflare triggers are unreadable; no PR opened.

final_questions.question: What GitHub permissions are still missing?
final_questions.answer: No extra broad grants demonstrated missing. Deploy key alone lacks REST abilities. A separately scoped preview App, webhook subscriptions/receiver and enforceable main protections are still needed; current App is excessive.

final_questions.question: What Cloudflare permissions are still missing?
final_questions.answer: Successful Workers Builds trigger READ (documented Workers CI Read, current role mapping Content Read-Only), plus separately scoped upload authority on a pre-provisioned isolated preview Worker. No DNS/production edit permission requested.

final_questions.question: What prevents full automatic preview preparation today?
final_questions.answer: Unaudited Cloudflare integration, disabled active Worker version URLs/no isolated proposal target, missing exact-head proposal CI/hosted evidence, and incomplete credential/main-protection isolation for unattended integration.

final_questions.question: Should GitHub eventually use a GitHub App instead of deploy keys?
final_questions.answer: YES: a separate selected-repository preview App with least privilege and short-lived installation tokens.

final_questions.question: Should OptiBrain clone repositories every day?
final_questions.answer: NO — use event-driven updates plus bounded reconciliation.

final_questions.question: Is this adapter ready for integration into OptiBrain after the post-Phase37 remediation finishes?
final_questions.answer: Contract and local preparation evidence are ready for integration review. Full unattended adapter integration is NOT READY until the safety/access/preview gaps are resolved. Backend integration and production executor are not implemented.
